fusions.name: Rigging Swing
fusions.desc: Casts a line to a target up to 6 tiles away and swings you to it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gunnysack Slam
fusions.desc: Bags the target in a conjured mesh and swings it into the ground for 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cargo Climb
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh onto a hold up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it hand over hand, instantly, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Knuckled Down
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you pull a mesh tight around yourself: a ward soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
